in_hebrew.name: Guidotti
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Guide of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Guidotti הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Italian name ‘Guidotti’. The name ‘Guidotti’ is derived from ‘Guidus’ or ‘Guido’, which means ‘Guide of God’ or ‘Man of God’. In the Middle Ages, Guidos were considered to be wise and trusted leaders. The name has been borne by many notable figures in history, including Guido of Arezzo, a musician and music theorist, and Guido da Montefeltro, a condottiere and ruler of Urbino.
